sloka: प्रहृष्टः तु अभवत् तेन वचनेन स राक्षसः ।परिष्वज्य सुसंश्लिष्टम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-४२-५॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭaḥ tu abhavat tena vacanena sa rākṣasaḥ ।pariṣvajya susaṁśliṣṭam idam vacanam abravīt ॥3-42-5॥

translations.english: Ravana was so overwhelmed with joy to hear those words that he embraced him tightly and said:.
